trigger: In the ration line: Kit lifting ration cards.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Three people up, Kit. She lifts a ration card from a man's back pocket like she's brushing off lint.

nodes.speaker: kit
nodes.text: Wrench! And the wolf! Okay, you didn't see that. You're my alibi.

nodes.speaker: kit
nodes.text: Oh. You. The bag guy. Please don't make this weird.

nodes.speaker: authority_guard
nodes.text: Hey! You in the goggles. Hands where I can see them.

choices.text: She took a card. Back pocket.

nodes.speaker: authority_guard
nodes.text: Together. Right. Both of you, step out. You lose your place. Next time I take the cards.

nodes.speaker: kit
nodes.text: You lost your spot for me. That's so stupid. Okay. Listen.

nodes.speaker: kit
nodes.text: At the desk they ask you for names. Hoarders. Don't give names. Names come back around.

nodes.speaker: kit
nodes.text: I owe you. I actually pay my debts. Ask anyone. Don't ask anyone.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The guard pats Kit down and finds nothing. The card's gone. So is she.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: They take her out of line. She doesn't look back. That's worse.
